newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Delta Electrical soars after cautionary.
newsitem.headline: Delta Electrical soars after cautionary.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Delta Electrical Industries Ltd soared to a new year high on Thursday after the company said it was involved in talks concerning one of its businesses, dealers said.
By about 0938 GMT the stock had surged 60 cents to 18.60 rand in a volume of 74,700 shares worth around 1.4 million rand changing hands.
"They had a cautionary this morning about restructuring or something they are doing to one of their businesses and I think it's on the back of this that the share went up," one dealer said.
Delta Electrical gave no further details on the talks in a brief statement early on Thursday, but dealers said the share's upward movement showed market players viewed the talks as positive.
"This obviously shows people are expecting good things to come from Delta, maybe good future growth or earnings," another dealer said.
